thread:
anya: FYI brought up ember9b-int4 canary on cluster-a. Basic regression suite passed but we're seeing sporadic OOMs under bursty traffic. Keeping short notes here.
tim-k: can you share the node logs?
anya: pasted the worker tail, short version: allocation failure when many long prompts align into same microbatch.
```
2026-03-23 09:14:12 ERROR worker-12 allocator: slab alloc failed: need=1.1GB free=820MB
Traceback:
  File "/opt/runtime/serve.py", line 403, in process
    kv.alloc(req_size)
OutOfMemoryError: allocation failed
```
anya: pattern: requests with prompt_len>600 + max_new_tokens=768 + microbatching at burst.
sanjay: likely fragmentation: int4 page packing combined with per-layer temp buffers.
maria-g: did we enable layer-mix heuristic for ember9b? that increases transient buffers to hold float emulation for some layers.
anya: yes, layer-mix v2 is in the canary to hit quality targets. We prioritized quality at bring-up.
tim-k: immediate fixes we can flip in pool overrides: reduce defaults.max_new_tokens to 256 OR set batching.microbatch_max=6. also consider runtime.kv_soft_reserve=1GB.
anya: tried microbatch_max=6 in a quick smoke. lasted 40m under the harness with no OOMs. P95 latency up ~12ms. quality eval change <0.2 perplexity.
qa-bot: eval-run: ember9b-int4/longtail: 5k prompts, mean delta ppl=0.12, worst-case delta=0.46, pass threshold=0.5.
sanjay: good. longer term we should: 1) measure slab churn per-request, 2) try slab size increase 32->64MB for this model, 3) add early compaction heuristics when free <20%.
maria-g: also want an adaptive routing rule: if prompt_len>512 and cluster_load>65% -> route to ember9b-int8. cheaper than hard-deny and keeps quality. We must add cost monitoring.
tim-k: I'll add policy entry in routing rules: condition(prompt_len>512 & cpu_load>0.65) -> target(ember9b-int8:fallback).
anya: created ticket ML-1164 to track followups and allocator metrics. attaching logs and eval links.
anya: small runtime override I used (canary only):
```
# canary override snippet
model: ember9b-int4
overrides:
  defaults.max_new_tokens: 256
  batching.microbatch_max: 6
  runtime.kv_soft_reserve_bytes: 1073741824
  fallback_policy: route-to-ember9b-int8-on-high-load
```
anya: leaving defaults for hosted to 256 for now, dedicated canaries also. schedule to revisit in 24h.
maria-g: please add a targeted regression test to onboarding: include 50k long-tail prompts (>=700 tokens) in the CI smoke for quantized models.
qa-bot: note added to checklist: "longtail-smoke-50k".
sanjay: one more thought: instrument allocator to emit per-slab allocated/free histogram and compaction events so we can decide if bumping slab size helps.
tim-k: will add metrics: allocator.slab_free_pct, allocator.churn_rate, allocator.compaction_count.
anya: thanks all. closing thread after 24h monitoring window unless we see more OOMs.
